meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把用户提供的文字(文章、笔记、主题、简报)转成一个无脸解说视频:规划教学故事、选设计预设、生成旁白与背景音乐、逐帧渲染成 MP4。不做网站或实景捕获,视觉按场景用排版、抽象图形、图表等现造。
howto.when: 当用户给出任意文本(如文章、笔记、主题)并要求做成无脸解说视频时触发;典型用于主题解说、概念分解、操作指南等。若意图不清晰或要基于网站做视频,则交给 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Claude turns any text into a faceless explainer video: plans story, picks design preset, generates narration/BGM, renders MP4. No capture; visuals invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, charts).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user gives text (article, notes, topic) and asks for a faceless explainer video — e.g., topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos. Not for website videos; unclear → /hyperframes.
